fryingpan.label: Fryingpan River above Basalt (test)
fryingpan.note: the acceptance test: UTM 13, Colorado (no state adapter), Ruedi Reservoir's cold release, the Fryingpan-Arkansas collection system, the 2018 Lake Christine fire, Hunter-Fryingpan Wilderness

au_sable.label: Au Sable River above Mio (test)
au_sable.note: the second test: a flat sandy outwash plain, kettle lakes, spring creeks, Mio Dam; UTM 16, Michigan

ruby.label: Ruby Mountains, Lamoille Canyon (test)
ruby.note: a desert range: closed basins ending in sinks (the Ruby Marshes), dry washes, alpine lakes; UTM 11, Nevada

cape_cod.label: Cape Cod, the Quashnet River (test)
cape_cod.note: coastal plain: tidal rivers, kettle ponds, cranberry-bog ditches, sea-run brook trout; UTM 19, Massachusetts

north_shore.label: Lake Superior's North Shore, Lutsen to Grand Marais (test)
north_shore.note: glaciated lake country: short steep creeks with falls into a Great Lake; UTM 15, Minnesota

montauk.label: Current River at Montauk (test)
montauk.note: karst: springs feeding trout water, losing and sinking streams; UTM 15, Missouri
